reading: A reading, joined by terms and definition: BigCommerce's Store logs is a control panel page of its own, Settings > Advanced > Store logs, where merchants go when 'the connection is unsuccessful or the response contains errors' (BC-S-0332), and its own System Logs endpoint is to 'Retrieve and filter store logs' and 'access log entries for debugging, auditing, and monitoring store activity' (BC-S-0331). WooCommerce's Logs is the page under Status where 'You can view the entries created by the logger' (WC-S-0038, WC-S-0920). Both are the store's own log entries, viewed in the admin. The same statement BC-S-0331 also names a separate Staff Action Logs endpoint, to audit staff users' actions in the control panel; it is a different log (see notes), and the landing rests on System Logs and Store logs. BigCommerce holds no system status page, CM-OPS-005's parent; the parent follows WooCommerce's grouping, the only one stated.

A reading, joined by terms: BigCommerce mobile app, a plan line on the plans Core, Growth, Scale and Performance (BC-S-0418), and WooCommerce mobile app (WC-S-0422) and Salla's تطبيق إدارة المتجر على أجهزة iOS و Android (SA-S-2082). The app is the merchant's: Commerce licenses it 'solely in connection with your Account for so long as your Services subscription remains in effect' (BC-S-0419), so it is not a shopper-facing store app (the homonym G-zid kept apart). What the app does, managing the store or push notifications, isn't stated in BigCommerce's statements: Q1 found no boundary or reason statement (gaps BC-C-077/boundary, BC-C-077/reason).
